_note: 18 generations: 12 daytime albedos for the existing facade slots (which are all NIGHT textures - the prompts that produced them literally say 'night, wet neon reflections in magenta and cyan', which is why the city glows magenta at midday), plus 6 brand-new styles.
_lighting: Every prompt asks for BRIGHT OVERCAST daylight, never direct sun. A texture with a hard directional shadow baked into it fights the game's own moving sun and looks wrong at every hour except the one it was generated for. Overcast bakes in form without baking in a light direction.
_framing: Formula carried over from prompts_facades_v2: describe the WALL not the BUILDING, name every unwanted element explicitly, and demand a camera perpendicular to the surface.
